The '''2027 Durban's Super Giants season''' is the fifth season of the franchise in the [[SA20]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BETWAY SA20 SEASON 5 FIXTURES ANNOUNCED |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-season-5-fixtures-announced |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The team is captained by [[Aiden Markram]] and coached by [[Lance Klusener]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Lance Klusener Reappointed as Head Coach of Durban's Super Giants for Fourth Season |url=https://www.durbanssupergiants.com/durban-super-giants/categories/press-release/lance-klusener-reappointed-head-coach-durbans-super-giants-sa20-2025-26 |access-date=3 August 2026 |website=SA20}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Durban’s Super Giants retain strong core ahead of SA20 Season 5|url=https://www.durbanssupergiants.com/news/durbans-super-giants-retention-sa20-season-5-2027 |access-date=3 August 2026 |website=Durban's Super Giants}}</ref>
